literal_meaning: basis for heedlessness through liquor and intoxicants
alternative_translations: drink and intoxicants leading to heedlessness
definition: Liquor and intoxicants taken as a basis for heedlessness, classically prohibited in ethical training.

example_phrases.translation: gives up intoxicants that lead to heedlessness and refrains from intoxicants that lead to heedlessness
example_phrases.notes: The fifth of the five great gifts in AN 8.39. Added 2026-09-13; the record previously carried a bare reference with no quoted source text.
